in_hebrew.name: Mariejeanne
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mary (Greek) and Jeanne (French form of Johanne/John)
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mariejeanne הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Mariejeanne is a name of French origin, derived from the Greek name Maria, meaning 'rebellion', and the French name Jeanne, meaning 'God is gracious'. This name is a combination of the two, symbolizing a strong, God-reliant woman with a rebellious spirit.
